mapper.select: select "UID" as "userid", pwd, name, gender, birth, is_lunar as "isLunar", cphone, email, habit, regdate as "regDate" from member where "UID"=#{userid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER("UID", PWD, NAME, GENDER, BIRTH, IS_LUNAR, CPHONE, EMAIL, HABIT, REGDATE) VALUES(#{userid}, #{pwd}, #{name}, #{gender,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{birth,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isLunar,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cphone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{habit,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
